title: IPDrive
tagline: InterPlanetary Drive is a decentralized drive built on top of IPFS

prizes.placement: 🗃 IPFS/Filecoin — Best use of web3.storage or nft.storage
prizes.title: IPFS and Filecoin

description:
IPDrive is a file storage service for users to store and share files in the decentralized internet. This service comes as a replacement for centralized services such as Dropbox, Google Drive and One Drive.

We plan to continue building this project and we are looking for people to help us. If you have interest, please reach out to us!
how_its_made: IPDrive, uses @Tableland to store and retrieve all the user metadata (e.g. folder structure), @IPFS to store and retrieve the files for the users, and @Covalent to convert the prices to USD. All the smart contracts were deployed in the @Polygon network, where we added a new subgraph in @TheGraph serving as an API.
